5 تدرّج He progressed, or advanced, by degrees, إِلَى شَىْءٍ to a thing. (TA.) He was, or became, drawn near, or he drew near, (S, Msb,) by degrees (عَلَى التَّدْرِيجِ, S), or by little and little, (Msb,) إِلَى كَذَا to such a thing, (S,) or إِلَى الأَمْرِ to the thing or affair. (Msb.) ―
-b2- And (tropical:) He became accustomed, or habituated, إِلَى كَذَا to such a thing. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
